article: Unsolved problems in number theory: perfect numbers, Goldbach, and the Riemann hypothesis
scope: Read the complete Japanese original and all twelve translations; compared meaning, mathematical terminology, formulas, internal article links and primary references. Corrected all editions and retained only the reviewed scope in the ledger.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date (2026-09-24), restored original publication date (2024-03-02), and set lastmod to the review date across 13 editions.
Updated the known even perfect number count from 51 to 52 based on the current GIMPS list; clarified no odd perfect number is known and both infinitude/existence questions remain open.
Defined primes as integers greater than 1 with positive divisors only 1 and themselves; distinguished the unproved binary Goldbach conjecture from Helfgott’s proved ternary theorem.

Corrected the Riemann zeta Dirichlet series convergence condition to Re(s)>1; explained analytic continuation and the simple pole at s=1, trivial zeros, critical strip, and the hypothesis for nontrivial zeros.
Added localized links to five primary references and preserved localized internal article links.
